notes.title: Major Update for June 2
notes.content:
Pipes
This week introduces a new block, Pipes, with 10 new levels to play. These levels are moderately late in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/76f8edf822e404db5bca0810f268a5050125581f.gif

Pipe blocks rapidly transfer heat around to a large fan, leading you to find ways to offload heat onto these pipes. The large fan that works to cool these new systems runs at a high cooling capacity, so use whatever you can to transfer as much heat to it as possible.

It has been a while, but for those who are still playing, I hope you're enjoying what I've made, and I have started working on a third game. If you are enjoying this weird heat transfer based puzzle game, please remember to leave a review on the store page, it helps a lot!

notes.title: Major Update for January 22
notes.content:
Junctions
This week introduces a new block, Junctions, with 10 new levels to play, right by the start of the game. The first 6 levels of this update are even in the demo, so try them out even if you haven't gotten the full game yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/419de6af8f1c347343e506dc70422123213a9937.gif

Junctions connect to other wires, while also transferring heat like heatsinks, so that you can build new designs without having either get in the way.

Additionally, this update contains a small client fix, where the game will reset its resolution if it tries to launch at a resolution much larger than your current monitor. Please let me know if this has any issues.

Finally, I really hope everyone's enjoying the game and the updates. If you are, the most helpful thing you can do is leave a review, it lets me know what works and what to work on. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Major Update for October 23
notes.content:
Growth
This week introduces 10 new levels that grow as you complete stages. Instead of gaining budget, gain space to open up your designs in these levels, in a twist on one of the game's core mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/fe33fde1b23e8912b30b087edc6c9a0865953a29.gif

These levels show up to the right of the Heat Exchanger levels, and are only slightly farther ahead in the game.

Finally, thanks for playing my game. If you like whatever amount of it you've played, I'd love to hear feedback from you. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Small patch for October 5
notes.content:
Added visuals for level completion while in level
You can now see if you've completed a level before while playing it, as a small checkmark or star will appear beside the level name in the top left. The game will also show if you've finished the level you're on, by keeping the border of the last stage highlighted even if it's no longer complete.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/b67160a09122d8843e013a8dc56f43c86dbfb97e.png

notes.title: Small patch for September 16
notes.content:
Fixed undo
Undo was crashing the game because I miscounted an index, it should work in all circumstances again.

notes.title: Major Update for September 11
notes.content:
Endgame
Today's update adds 20 levels past the end of the game. If you haven't gotten that far, don't worry, they'll be there when you do. These new levels feature a new mechanic that you'll have to figure out on your own, and an extension to that mechanic once you get comfortable with it. These levels can be moderately difficult, but don't worry, I believe in you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/725890bc60f4648b2ab484494129e2096cd146d2.gif

Today's update also adds achievements for completing 12 diamond levels and getting 20 bonus stars. The levels included in today's update include quite a few bonus stars, so don't worry about having to get every last one. Yet.

Finally, thank you so much for playing my game. I know it's weird, but I do hope everyone is having fun. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Small patch for August 29
notes.content:
Fixed an achievement
Fixed a bug with the achievement Out of It not being awarded for completing [spoiler]level 54, which [spoiler]is still the end of the game for about the next two weeks.[/spoiler][/spoiler]

notes.title: Small patch for August 11
notes.content:
Centering camera
Pressing the Center Camera key, or pressing right stick in on controller, now has a nice little animation for recentering the board, rather than just snapping it to the center.

notes.title: Small patch for August 7
notes.content:
Added an extra tutorial level
This added level is optional, and is being added based on feedback that some parts of the game may not be clear enough to newer players.

Resolution bug
Some users have encountered a bug where the game becomes unresponsive if the game's resolution is set to a higher resolution than the user's monitor. This fix should stop players from accidentally choosing too high of a resolution, however if any players do encounter this bug again, please let me know.

Steam Rich Presence
The current level you're working on will now be displayed as your game state on your Steam Friends List.

notes.title: Major Update for July 31
notes.content:
Heat Exchangers
Heat exchangers... well... exchange heat with each other. This is a new block, including 10 new levels, that will appear at the bottom of the task list, just below processor blocks. Heat exchanger blocks all stay at the same temperature, which means that you can generate heat by one heat exchanger, and cool another one as if they were adjacent to each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/d7152c23a50fe9ba43256430fbd35e82addbde9d.gif

Workshop Support
This update also includes workshop support. You can load custom levels into the game by dragging and dropping level files into the game, and if you can complete them, an upload button will appear in the top left to upload your level to the Steam Workshop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/1b764102e6e8ee095ff450a73e222f0405834484.gif

Once you set a level public, others can download them, and they'll appear in the game client, just below the new Heat Exchanger levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44015100/e98ed1a3000d4b71cdd11aca92bd09f98314dde0.png

Small note...

This is my first time implementing workshop support, ever, so if anything doesn't work please report it.

Finally, thank you for playing my game, I genuinely appreciate it. If you're enjoying the game, the best thing you can do is leave a review on Steam. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Small patch for June 29
notes.content: When in a level, the game client will now show the name of the current level in the top left.

notes.title: Small patch for June 27
notes.content:
When loading a previous Sandbox, the game should properly center the camera on the center of the board.
Levels will now show if they have an incomplete bonus star available.

notes.title: Small patch for June 21
notes.content: Moving game saves to Saved Games folder. The game will move your saves automatically on launch.

notes.title: Small patch for June 21
notes.content: Some players may have had issues where the game crashes when it attempts to save a file, such as settings or progress. This may happen if the game doesn't have access to your My Documents folder. If this occurs, the game will now save a copy of your progress to its own folder, however these local saves cannot be uploaded to Steam Cloud.
